introduction.title: Advanced Testing and Debugging in PEGA
introduction.text: Comprehensive testing and effective debugging are essential for delivering high-quality PEGA applications. This advanced coverage includes sophisticated testing strategies, debugging techniques, automated testing frameworks, and quality assurance practices that ensure robust, reliable enterprise applications.

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: Advanced testing strategies include TDD, BDD, and risk-based approaches
Automated testing frameworks provide comprehensive coverage across all application layers
Sophisticated debugging techniques enable efficient problem resolution
Performance testing validates application scalability and reliability
Quality assurance processes ensure consistent delivery of high-quality applications
Test data management strategies support realistic and comprehensive testing
Monitoring and observability provide insights for continuous improvement
Following testing best practices leads to robust and maintainable applications
